title: Galilean One-Particle Kinematics from a Smooth Family of Reference States
summary: Giannelli and Chiribella derived an observable-generator duality for energy from a collision model of informational nonequilibrium. We study a continuous-variable version aimed at the Galilean one-particle sector. A smooth family of reference states around an isotropic equilibrium supplies time, translation, rotation, and boost directions. The local observable-generator correspondence is obtained by differentiating a smooth extension of the single-state duality map, and the norm-one property of localization is obtained from a fiducial focusing assumption together with covariance.
